info.name: GoEvent isolated admin API
info.description: Destructive acceptance tests for the disposable admin_postman_smoke.py harness only. Never run against shared or production databases. Generated credentials are supplied in a temporary local environment; no cloud reporting.

exec: pm.test("Member cannot use admin login", () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test("Reject password in profile edit", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test("Admin CSRF after member login", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
